Fourteen posts for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok: four silent Reels, nine 4:5 stills and a five-slide Superhome checklist carousel, plus a profile picture and a Facebook cover. Tap a picture for the full-size file. “Copy caption” puts the caption on your clipboard.

04Carousel · 5 slides · 4:5

Carousel: the Superhome checklist (5 slides)

Don’t get ahead of yourself 🛑 Superhome or terrace, the same steps apply.

1. Layout first. Where’s the dishwasher going, where are the seats going, where are the fridges going.
2. Tiles, finishes and kitchen units come LATER.
3. Spend on the entrance hall. It’s the bit everyone remembers.
4. Point the glass at the view.

Save this for when you start yours 📌
